crossRefs.note: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

translations.web: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.
translations.bsb: and said, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
translations.kjv: They say unto him, Master, this woman was taken in adultery, in the very act.
translations.asv: they say unto him, Teacher, this woman hath been taken in adultery, in the very act.
